currentProjectContext.finding: The announced December 2027 partial-operations phase is not a Makati segment.
DOTr has cited full NSCR operation by 2032; this is system-level and is not treated as a guaranteed Makati station opening date.

openingTimeline.rule: Do not publish a Makati Buendia/EDSA opening date until DOTr/NSCR provides a segment- or station-specific operating schedule.

civicMapModelAssessment.problem: This field describes mapping/verification state, not whether a transport facility is operating, suspended, under construction, future, or permanently closed.
civicMapModelAssessment.decision: Do not overload the current status field to represent service lifecycle.

recommendedLifecycleModel.defaultFilterRule: The normal Civic Map should show operating assets by default. Suspended/closed/future assets should appear only when the user enables a history/future-infrastructure layer or on a relevant project/history page.
recommendedLifecycleModel.duplicateRule: Legacy PNR and future NSCR stations may share corridor geography but must remain distinct records when identity or lifecycle differs.

integrityRulesForFutureImplementation: Never show Dela Rosa, Pasay Road or legacy EDSA as currently operating PNR stops while the March 2024 suspension remains in force.
Never show NSCR Buendia or NSCR EDSA as operating until an authoritative source confirms passenger service.
Do not alias Dela Rosa to NSCR Buendia.
Do not invent a Pasay Road NSCR successor.
Keep legacy PNR EDSA and future NSCR EDSA lifecycle-distinct even if their footprints overlap.
